lines.zh: 我踩着南瓜藤走，瓜叶一路断裂。
lines.en: I walk the pumpkin vines and break the leaves behind me.

lines.zh: 橙色的壳在夜里像一盏没点的灯。
lines.en: My orange shell sits like an unlit lantern in the dark.

lines.zh: 我拖着瓜秧走，脚步沉得像土块。
lines.en: I drag my vines along, each step heavy as a clod.

lines.zh: 田埂上我一步一步，把瓜压倒。
lines.en: Along the ridge I flatten every melon I pass.

lines.zh: 我的瓜籽在体内滚，走一步响一声。
lines.en: Seeds roll inside me, clicking once per step.

lines.zh: 南瓜地是我的路，我走得很慢。
lines.en: The pumpkin field is my road, and I walk it slowly.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，藤蔓都朝我弯。
lines.en: Where I pass, the vines bend toward me.

lines.zh: 刻出的嘴在走路时一张一合。
lines.en: The mouth I was carved keeps opening as I walk.

lines.zh: 我绕开稻草人，它站得比我直。
lines.en: I go around the scarecrow; it stands straighter than I do.

lines.zh: 夜露打湿瓜皮，走起来更滑。
lines.en: Night dew slicks my rind, and my steps slide.

lines.zh: 我把影子压在瓜叶上走。
lines.en: I press my shadow down on the pumpkin leaves.

lines.zh: 我朝你的火把走，橙皮发烫。
lines.en: I walk toward your torch and my orange skin grows hot.

lines.zh: 我站进瓜堆里，你就分不出我。
lines.en: I stand among the pumpkins and you cannot tell me apart.

lines.zh: 肚子里的烛火灭了，我还是醒着。
lines.en: The candle in me went out, yet I am still awake.

lines.zh: 风摇藤蔓，只有我不摇。
lines.en: Wind shakes the vines; only I stay still.

lines.zh: 我在等秋天把最后一片叶吹落。
lines.en: I wait for autumn to blow down the last leaf.

lines.zh: 瓜蒂上一只甲虫爬过，我没动。
lines.en: A beetle crawls over my stem and I do not move.

lines.zh: 我数田里的南瓜，数到自己就停。
lines.en: I count the field's pumpkins and stop when I reach myself.

lines.zh: 稻草人盯着我，我也盯着它。
lines.en: The scarecrow stares at me; I stare back.

lines.zh: 夜里没有太阳，我的皮还是暖的。
lines.en: No sun tonight, yet my rind stays warm.

lines.zh: 我听见镰刀挂在木桩上的声音。
lines.en: I hear a scythe swinging on its wooden post.

lines.zh: 有人忘了收瓜，我就一直等。
lines.en: Someone forgot to harvest; so I keep waiting.

lines.zh: 我刻出来的眼睛，正对着你的脸。
lines.en: The eyes carved into me point straight at your face.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，我的眼窝就亮了。
lines.en: Lift your torch and my eyeholes light up.

lines.zh: 我看你手里的镰刀，比看你的脸久。
lines.en: I watch the scythe in your hand longer than your face.

lines.zh: 你身上有瓜汁味，藏不住的。
lines.en: You smell of pumpkin juice; you cannot hide it.

lines.zh: 我歪一下瓜头，颈上的藤嘎吱响。
lines.en: I tilt my pumpkin head and the neck vines creak.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进我嘴里，我合不上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls into my mouth and I cannot close it.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的靴子，泥还是新的。
lines.en: I stare at your boots; the mud is still fresh.

lines.zh: 你不眨眼，我的烛芯也不闪。
lines.en: You do not blink, and my wick does not flicker.

lines.zh: 我抬高瓜蒂，正好够到你的下巴。
lines.en: I raise my stem until it reaches your chin.

lines.zh: 我记住了你站在第几垄瓜地里。
lines.en: I will remember which row of melons you stood in.

lines.zh: 瓜皮裂了，瓤往外挤。
lines.en: My rind splits and the flesh pushes out.

lines.zh: 疼，但我的嘴刻着，喊不出来。
lines.en: It hurts, but my mouth is carved and cannot scream.

lines.zh: 南瓜壳裂了，里头的火苗晃。
lines.en: My pumpkin shell cracks and the flame inside wavers.

lines.zh: 我的烛芯晃得厉害。
lines.en: My candle wick wavers hard.

lines.zh: 瓜籽从伤口漏到地上。
lines.en: Seeds leak from the wound onto the ground.

lines.zh: 别打头，头是空的。
lines.en: Do not hit my head; it is hollow.

lines.zh: 我裂开一半，还能走。
lines.en: I am split halfway and I can still walk.

lines.zh: 痛从瓜蒂一直传到根上。
lines.en: The pain runs from my stem down to my roots.

lines.zh: 我的瓤被削掉一块。
lines.en: A chunk of my flesh has been cut away.

lines.zh: 再来一下，我就只剩皮了。
lines.en: One more hit and only my skin will be left.

lines.zh: 南瓜派递到我面前，我连嘴都不张。
lines.en: You hold out pumpkin pie and I do not even open my mouth.

lines.zh: 你用瓜籽引我？我肚子里全是瓜籽。
lines.en: Seeds to lure me? My body is full of them.

lines.zh: 我摇了摇头，瓜里的籽哗啦响。
lines.en: I shake my head and the seeds inside rattle.

lines.zh: 食物留给你，我只要你的脚步声。
lines.en: Keep the food; I only want the sound of your steps.

lines.zh: 我闻到糖霜，可我的牙是刻的。
lines.en: I smell icing, but my teeth are only carved.

lines.zh: 别拿南瓜喂南瓜，这不合规矩。
lines.en: Do not feed a pumpkin to a pumpkin; it is improper.

lines.zh: 你把瓜灯举高，我只想撞你。
lines.en: You raise the jack-o'-lantern; I only want to ram you.

lines.zh: 我的嘴是三角口，装不下你的好意。
lines.en: My mouth is a triangle and too small for your kindness.

lines.zh: 甜味飘过来，我的烛火晃了一下。
lines.en: The sweetness drifts past and my candle flame wavers.

lines.zh: 收起你的瓜，我跟着你不是为这个。
lines.en: Put your melon away; I am not following you for that.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我滚了半圈又站直。
lines.en: You crash into me; I roll half a turn and stand up.

lines.zh: 瓜皮裂了一道，露出里面的瓤。
lines.en: My rind splits and the flesh inside shows.

lines.zh: 别推我，我的籽会从缝里漏出来。
lines.en: Stop pushing or my seeds will leak through the cracks.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，像两只要破的瓜。
lines.en: We collide like two melons about to burst.

lines.zh: 我的瓜身很沉，撞得你退半步。
lines.en: My body is heavy, and it knocks you back half a step.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的藤，我差点被绊倒。
lines.en: You step on my vine and I almost fall.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，我头上的蒂歪了。
lines.en: After the bump, the stem on my head sits crooked.

lines.zh: 我滚到田边，把一垄瓜苗压平。
lines.en: I roll to the field edge and flatten a row of shoots.

lines.zh: 你挡路，我就用整个瓜身挤过去。
lines.en: You block the way, so I squeeze past with my whole body.

lines.zh: 瓜壳闷响一声，夜里的虫都停了。
lines.en: My rind thuds once and the night insects go quiet.

lines.zh: 这片瓜地只有我一个会走路的。
lines.en: I am the only one in this field who walks.

lines.zh: 我试过对瓜说话，它不会答。
lines.en: I tried speaking to a pumpkin; it does not answer.

lines.zh: 没有谁和我配对，我是自己长出来的。
lines.en: Nothing pairs with me; I grew on my own.

lines.zh: 我找过同类，找到的全是死瓜。
lines.en: I looked for my kind and found only dead melons.

lines.zh: 藤上开过花，花谢了也没结果。
lines.en: A flower opened on my vine, then died without fruit.

lines.zh: 我对着月亮站了一夜，什么也没发生。
lines.en: I stood at the moon all night and nothing happened.

lines.zh: 要是再长出一个我，我们会打起来。
lines.en: If another me grew, we would fight.

lines.zh: 我的影子只有一个，不会多。
lines.en: I cast only one shadow, and it never multiplies.

lines.zh: 没有伴侣，我就把稻草人当邻居。
lines.en: With no mate, I treat the scarecrow as a neighbour.

lines.zh: 这一季的瓜都熟了，只有我活着。
lines.en: Every melon ripened this season; only I am alive.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉在地上的瓜籽，塞进缝里。
lines.en: I pick up fallen seeds and tuck them into my cracks.

lines.zh: 一把烂瓜瓤，我当宝贝收起来。
lines.en: A handful of rotten flesh, and I keep it like treasure.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很费劲，瓜蒂差点断。
lines.en: Bending is hard; my stem nearly snaps.

lines.zh: 地上有块南瓜灯碎片，我捡了。
lines.en: A shard of a jack-o'-lantern lies there; I take it.

lines.zh: 我抱起一整个瓜，走两步就放下。
lines.en: I lift a whole pumpkin, take two steps, and set it down.

lines.zh: 铁粒落进我手里，我握不住。
lines.en: Iron nuggets fall into my hands, and I cannot hold them.

lines.zh: 我把镰刀捡起来，又扔回田里。
lines.en: I pick up a scythe and toss it back into the field.

lines.zh: 有人掉了面包，我踩了过去。
lines.en: Someone dropped bread; I step over it.

lines.zh: 我捡起自己的瓜蒂，装回原位。
lines.en: I pick up my own stem and put it back in place.

lines.zh: 东西进不了我的嘴，只能抱在怀里。
lines.en: Nothing fits my mouth, so I carry things against my chest.

lines.zh: 田那头有人，我的烛芯一下亮了。
lines.en: Someone is across the field, and my wick flares.

lines.zh: 你踩断一根藤，我就知道你在哪。
lines.en: You snap a vine and I know exactly where you are.

lines.zh: 瓜叶一动，我整个身子转过去。
lines.en: A leaf moves and my whole body turns toward it.

lines.zh: 我闻到了活人的汗味，很新鲜。
lines.en: I smell fresh sweat on a living thing.

lines.zh: 你举着火把，正好照出你的位置。
lines.en: You hold up a torch, which marks your position for me.

lines.zh: 我听见你的靴子碾过干土。
lines.en: I hear your boots grinding over dry soil.

lines.zh: 我盯上你了，从你踏进瓜地开始。
lines.en: I marked you the moment you stepped into the field.

lines.zh: 你离我七步，这个距离够了。
lines.en: Seven steps away; that is close enough.

lines.zh: 夜里没有别的动静，只有你。
lines.en: Nothing else stirs tonight; only you.

lines.zh: 我把瓜头压低，像要冲过去。
lines.en: I lower my pumpkin head as if to charge.

lines.zh: 你在稻草人后面，我看得见。
lines.en: You are behind the scarecrow, and I can see you.

lines.zh: 我选了你，别的活物先放过。
lines.en: I choose you; other living things can wait.

lines.zh: 你回头看了一眼，那就晚了。
lines.en: You glanced back once, and that was too late.

lines.zh: 我停下脚步，因为目标已经确定。
lines.en: I stop walking because the target is settled.

lines.zh: 瓜蔓被你踩断，气味就露了你。
lines.en: You crush a vine, and its smell gives you away.

lines.zh: 你弯腰摘瓜，我就在你后面。
lines.en: You bend to pick a pumpkin; I am behind you.

lines.zh: 我追着你，瓜籽在体内撞得响。
lines.en: I chase you and my seeds bang around inside me.

lines.zh: 你往左跑，我的瓜头先转过去。
lines.en: You run left and my pumpkin head turns first.

lines.zh: 藤蔓绊我一下，我没停。
lines.en: A vine trips me, and I do not stop.

lines.zh: 我不喊，瓜壳里的响动就是喊。
lines.en: I do not shout; the knocking in my rind is the shout.

lines.zh: 你跑进麦田，我就把麦子压倒。
lines.en: You run into the wheat, and I flatten it.

lines.zh: 再快一点，我的瓜皮已经开始裂。
lines.en: Faster, or my rind will split from the effort.

lines.zh: 火烧不到我，我只会更亮。
lines.en: Fire cannot burn me; it only makes me brighter.

lines.zh: 你翻过栅栏，我直接撞过去。
lines.en: You climb the fence; I go straight through it.

lines.zh: 我离你四步，瓜里的烛火乱晃。
lines.en: Four steps behind, and my candle gutters wildly.

lines.zh: 你回头看，正好看见我的三角嘴。
lines.en: You look back and see my triangular mouth.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的火把，光不会骗人。
lines.en: I follow your torch; light does not lie.

lines.zh: 你喘气的声音越来越近。
lines.en: Your breathing sounds closer with every step.

lines.zh: 别躲进瓜地，那里是我的。
lines.en: Do not hide in the pumpkin field; that is mine.

lines.zh: 我一直在你后面，从没跟丢。
lines.en: I have been behind you the whole time, never losing you.

lines.zh: 你往田埂跑，那边的瓜是我的。
lines.en: You run for the ridge, but those pumpkins are mine.

lines.zh: 我一步一步跟，瓜壳一路滴水。
lines.en: I keep pace step for step, water leaking from my rind.

lines.zh: 你举盾，我就撞你的盾边。
lines.en: You raise a shield, so I ram its rim.

lines.zh: 我踩坏自己的瓜，也要追你。
lines.en: I crush my own pumpkins to keep chasing you.

lines.zh: 你回头看，瓜叶被我一层层掀开。
lines.en: You look back; I peel the leaves aside layer by layer.

lines.zh: 你躲到井后，我堵在井口。
lines.en: You hide behind the well; I block its mouth.

lines.zh: 我用整个瓜身撞你，闷响一声。
lines.en: I ram you with my whole body and it lands with a thud.

lines.zh: 我的瓜头砸下去，颈上的藤崩开。
lines.en: I swing my pumpkin head down and a neck vine snaps.

lines.zh: 你挡了一下，瓜皮凹进去一块。
lines.en: You block it, and my rind dents inward.

lines.zh: 我张开三角嘴，咬不住也咬。
lines.en: I open my triangle mouth and bite, though it cannot hold.

lines.zh: 我一头撞在你胸口，籽撒了一地。
lines.en: I butt your chest and seeds scatter on the ground.

lines.zh: 瓜瓤从裂口挤出来，我还是往前。
lines.en: Flesh squeezes from the crack, and I keep pushing.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我就再撞一次。
lines.en: You step back, so I ram you again.

lines.zh: 我的攻击没有花招，只有重量。
lines.en: My attacks have no tricks, only weight.

lines.zh: 瓜蒂抽在你手臂上，留下绿痕。
lines.en: My stem whips your arm and leaves a green mark.

lines.zh: 你砍掉我半边脸，我照样撞。
lines.en: You cut off half my face; I still ram you.

lines.zh: 我压住你的盾，瓜身往下沉。
lines.en: I press down on your shield and my body sinks.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我自己的瓤都散了。
lines.en: That blow scatters my own flesh inside.

lines.zh: 你听见瓜壳碎的声音，别高兴太早。
lines.en: You hear my shell crack, but do not celebrate yet.

lines.zh: 我滚过去，把你连人带草压住。
lines.en: I roll over and pin you down with the grass.

lines.zh: 我把瓜蒂缠上你的手腕，收紧。
lines.en: I coil my stem around your wrist and tighten.

lines.zh: 我的瓜身砸你后背，籽飞出来。
lines.en: My body slams your back and seeds fly out.

lines.zh: 你砍开我的壳，瓤里的烛还亮。
lines.en: You split my rind, yet the candle inside still burns.

lines.zh: 我翻个身压下来，很沉。
lines.en: I roll over onto you; I am heavy.

lines.zh: 我用裂开的边角划你的手。
lines.en: I rake your hand with a broken edge.

lines.zh: 这一下把我自己撞进泥里。
lines.en: That blow drives me into the mud as well.

lines.zh: 万圣节的风一吹，我就从土里冒头。
lines.en: A Halloween wind blows and I push up from the soil.

lines.zh: 瓜田里亮起一点烛火，我睁眼了。
lines.en: A candle lights in the field and I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我从南瓜堆里站起来，藤还挂着。
lines.en: I rise from the pumpkin pile with vines still on me.

lines.zh: 夜露落在我刚刻好的脸上。
lines.en: Night dew settles on my freshly carved face.

lines.zh: 有人把瓜灯放在田里，我借它活了。
lines.en: Someone left a lantern in the field and I borrowed its life.

lines.zh: 我从土里钻出，带出一串瓜根。
lines.en: I climb out of the ground trailing a string of roots.

lines.zh: 十月末的夜里，我第一个醒。
lines.en: On a late October night, I am the first to wake.

lines.zh: 瓜皮还没干，我已经会走路了。
lines.en: My rind is still wet, and already I can walk.

lines.zh: 我在稻草人脚边成形，它没让位。
lines.en: I form at the scarecrow's feet and it does not move aside.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋一落地，我就滚了出来。
lines.en: The spawn egg hits the ground and I roll out of it.

lines.zh: 黑暗里先有烛芯，然后才有我。
lines.en: First the wick appears in the dark, then me.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，田里所有的瓜都朝我。
lines.en: When I open my eyes, every pumpkin in the field faces me.

lines.zh: 火燎上瓜皮，焦味很甜。
lines.en: Fire licks my rind and the scorched smell is sweet.

lines.zh: 从高处滚下来，我碎了一角。
lines.en: Rolling from a height, I break off one corner.

lines.zh: 水灌进瓜壳，我沉得很慢。
lines.en: Water fills my shell and I sink very slowly.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，籽飞了一地。
lines.en: The blast flips me over and seeds fly everywhere.

lines.zh: 箭扎进瓜里，像插了根签子。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in me like a skewer.

lines.zh: 魔法钻进瓜壳，烛火变成蓝色。
lines.en: Magic seeps into my shell and the flame turns blue.

lines.zh: 我不用吃，可我的藤饿得发黄。
lines.en: I need no food, yet my vines yellow with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的脸烧成炭黑。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my face burns charcoal black.

lines.zh: 根须悬空，藤蔓也垂下去了。
lines.en: My roots hang in nothing, vines drooping.
